description: Show the new messages of the systemd journal as they arrive (the equivalent of tail -f).

parameters.label: Initial lines
parameters.description: Number of lines to show before following

examples.description: Show the last 100 lines of syslog
Keep following even when the file is recreated

lines.label: Lignes initiales
